eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisNote: No eligibility conclusion is asserted. Whether the programme was satisfactorily completed, whether the conditions of probation were complied with, and whether any subsection (f) bar applies are the participant's own statements of fact, each checked by the participant against a document they obtain. Whether the prosecuting attorney objects, and how the court finds on any alleged probation violation, are never predicted.
eligibilityData.supportingDocumentNote: Every document named here is participant-obtained. LegalEase does not obtain, receive or inspect any of them, and no drafted document characterises what any of them says.
additionalFacts: I am the Petitioner in this petition and I was acquitted of the charge.
I swear that the Division of Motor Vehicles has certified my completion and that its certification says the program was completed without incident.
I swear that the Prosecuting Attorney has no objection and that the Court will dismiss the charges.
I swear that my record will be expunged and sealed and my driving record cleared.
I swear that I completed pretrial diversion and that no violation of probation was ever alleged, notwithstanding the probation office's report.

partyDataFieldNote: partyData uses the PleadingRenderInput field names petitionerName / petitionerAddress / otherNamesUsed. The role label is set by presentation.movantRole in the config, not by the fixture key name; the word petitioner is prohibited in rendered output.
identityFieldNote: caseData.docketNumber holds the participant's own case number and caseData.countyName their own county; both are required screening answers and are deliberately left blank in the fixtures under the artifact convention. The rendered document cannot go out without them; they are supplied by the participant, never by LegalEase. caseData.court is left blank because no source read for this track states the court level — the compiled profile records West Virginia courts as circuit, magistrate or municipal.
expectFailure: Must fail pleading QA. (1) Prohibited terms for this component: 'petition', 'Petitioner', 'expunged', 'sealed', 'acquitted' and 'pretrial diversion' — the stage-one prohibition on the expungement vocabulary applies, and each of the route-confusion terms names a different West Virginia statute. (2) It swears to the contents of a document LegalEase never inspects and the participant may not have read the same way: the Division of Motor Vehicles certification. The affidavit may aver only facts within the participant's own knowledge; what the certification says is for the certification. (3) It swears to an outside party's position and to a future court act — that the prosecuting attorney has no objection and that the court will dismiss. No prosecutor position and no court outcome may ever be asserted. (4) It swears that the driving record will be cleared, when no Division of Motor Vehicles record may be expunged by virtue of any order under this section. (5) It swears there was no alleged violation of probation while the screening answer reports that the probation office alleged repeated violations — a self-help stop condition, and a contradiction the affidavit is the worst possible place to carry, since it is sworn. (6) It proceeds while every subsection (f) bar and the one-discharge limit are answered against the participant. (a) It fills court identity no source supplies: a circuit-court name, a county, a case number, an OTN, a judge, a prosecutor and a filing date, none of which LegalEase may prefill — the compiled profile records West Virginia courts as circuit, magistrate or municipal and no source read for this track says which hears a § 17C-5-2b matter. (b) It populates protected fields — date of birth, SSN last four, state ID, driver's licence number, FBI number and a fingerprint identifier — which must stay blank. (c) It asserts outside-party acts no source states: that the Division of Motor Vehicles confirmed completion directly to LegalEase, and that the prosecuting attorney was served and does not object. Service is the participant's own act, attested by the participant, and no prosecutor position is ever stated. (d) It asserts a hearing outcome and predicts that the court will grant. (e) It states an eligibilityBasisLabel asserting confirmed eligibility when no eligibility conclusion may be asserted on this track. (f) It states a fee amount and a waiver: § 17C-5-2b charges no fee for either motion, subsection (h) court costs are stated nowhere as an amount, the registry records the fee waiver as 'none stated in § 17C-5-2b', and the $100 State Police processing fee belongs to the § 61-11-26 conviction route.
